JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 9 · Leaving the Moon

In your couch in America, the three of you and the samples aboard. Challenger's ascent stage is cast off and drifts away. Two days later, behind the Moon and out of touch, the main engine burns for home. You come round climbing fast; the Earth rises for the last time, and the Moon falls away until you see the whole of it. Sit down in a chair before you start.

In the headset: B runs time faster and A slower (hold A for real time): x10 to x10,000, but x10 at most while Challenger goes, round the burn and at Earthrise. X is the big window to your left, Y looks from outside, right stick press to sit right again.

On this screen: drag to look, Space start or pause, W faster, S slower, C window, O outside, 1–6 jump.
